shots.0101_settings_lot_generation.png: Top Farm settings: Approach B (automated estate flock lot allocation) dated by the Chick Arrival Date, with an automatically created Flock analytic account in the Flock Batches plan.
shots.0102_settings_laying_transition.png: Laying Phase transition: the Farm Managers are alerted at a 50 % rolling 7-day hen-day rate from 17 weeks; daily operations: feed and medication consumption locations, egg store and graded egg products.
shots.0103_analytic_plans_cages.png: Analytic accounts of the Flock Batches and Farm Cages plans, grouped by plan: only Farm Cages has accounts yet, one per cage (IHL Cage A-01 to A-05, BDG Battery B-01). Flock accounts are created automatically when a flock is dispatched.
shots.0104_farm_infrastructure.png: Permanent farm infrastructure: two estates with their estate codes, a brooding nursery each, laying sheds grouping the cages, and the cages with their cage analytic accounts. No batch locations.
shots.0105_farm_ihl_estate_code.png: Farm Facility Ihalapannawa Estate with estate code IHL (used to name its flock lots) and its egg store.
shots.0106_cage_analytic_account.png: Cage A-01 in Laying Shed A, mapped to its permanent cage analytic account [A-01] in the Farm Cages plan.
shots.0107_product_layer_bird.png: Bird product: Is Live Farm Bird, tracked By Lots (hatchery lot, then flock lot), category Live Birds, cost LKR 150.
shots.0108_product_starter_feed.png: Feed product Starter Crumbs (Weeks 0-4): Farm Input Type = Feed, category Feed, cost LKR 140 per kg.
shots.0109_product_vaccine.png: Medicine product Marek's Vaccine (dose): Farm Input Type = Medication / Vaccine, cost LKR 58.
shots.0110_category_live_birds.png: Product category Live Birds: automated (perpetual) inventory valuation at standard price, stock account 140100 Livestock (Birds).
shots.0201_po_chicks.png: Purchase order P00001 for the day-old chicks: 10,000 pullets at LKR 150 from the hatchery, confirmed.
shots.0202_receipt_chicks_ready.png: Chick receipt into the main warehouse (WH/Stock), Ready.
shots.0203_receipt_hatchery_batch_number.png: Receipt line detail: the hatchery batch number 20_10_2026 is entered as the lot of the 10,000 chicks.
shots.0204_receipt_chicks_done.png: Chick receipt WH/IN/00001 validated (Done): 10,000 birds received into the main warehouse WH/Stock (their lot 20_10_2026 is shown on the previous and the next figure).
shots.0205_hatchery_lot.png: Hatchery lot 20_10_2026: Chick Arrival Date stamped by the receipt; it is not a flock (Flock Batch unticked).
shots.0206_po_feed.png: Feed purchase: Starter Crumbs 1,000 kg, Grower Mash 1,500 kg, Layer Mash 1,000 kg.
shots.0208_po_medicine.png: Medicine purchase: Marek's 10,000 doses, Newcastle ND-IB 10,000 doses, Electrolyte & Vitamin Mix 50 L.
shots.0210_main_warehouse_stock.png: Main warehouse stock after the purchases: 10,000 chicks under hatchery lot 20_10_2026, the feed (kg) and the medicine (doses, litres). The footer total adds different units and has no meaning.
shots.0301_estate_supply_ready.png: Estate supply transfer WH/INT/00001 (Ready) from WH/Stock to the Ihalapannawa Estate: Starter Crumbs 600 kg, Grower Mash 1,500 kg, Layer Mash 1,000 kg, Marek's 5,000 doses, Newcastle ND-IB 10,000 doses, Electrolyte & Vitamin Mix 50 L.
shots.0302_estate_supply_done.png: Estate supply validated: its moves show the feed put away in the IHL Feed Silo and the medicine in the IHL Medicine Store.
shots.0303_dispatch_ready_flock_lot_column.png: Dispatch of 5,000 chicks from WH/Stock to Ihalapannawa Brooding-01. The Flock Lot column appears for a dispatch to brooding; in Approach B it is generated on validation.
shots.0304_dispatch_hatchery_lot_reserved.png: The dispatch takes the chicks out of the main warehouse under their hatchery batch number 20_10_2026.
shots.0305_dispatch_done_flock_lot.png: Dispatch validated: the new flock lot IHL-20-10-2026 ([Estate Code]-[Chick Arrival Date]) is shown on the line.
shots.0306_flock_lot_brooding.png: Flock lot IHL-20-10-2026: Flock Batch in Brooding stage, Ihalapannawa Estate, chick arrival date, own Flock analytic account, 5,000 birds placed at LKR 750,000.
shots.0307_relabelling_moves.png: Moves history of the birds: receipt under 20_10_2026, dispatch to Brooding-01, then re-labelling through Flock Lot Conversion (out under 20_10_2026, back in under IHL-20-10-2026).
shots.0308_brooding_location.png: Brooding-01 now holds the flock IHL-20-10-2026: 5,000 live birds.
shots.0309_analytic_flock_account_created.png: The Flock Batches plan now holds the account IHL-20-10-2026, created automatically with the flock lot; cages keep their Farm Cages accounts.
shots.0401_manual_mode_refused.png: Approach A (manual entry): validating the dispatch to Baddegama Brooding-01 without a flock lot is refused; the message suggests the name built from the estate code and the arrival date.
shots.0402_manual_flock_lot_entered.png: The clerk types the flock lot BDG-20-10-2026 in the Flock Lot column of the dispatch line.
shots.0403_manual_dispatch_done.png: Dispatch WH/INT/00003 validated (Done): the line carries the clerk-entered flock lot BDG-20-10-2026. The 5,000 chicks were re-labelled from hatchery lot 20_10_2026 on validation, as the flock lot's chatter shows on the next figure.
shots.0404_manual_flock_lot.png: Flock lot BDG-20-10-2026 completed at validation: Brooding stage, Baddegama Estate, arrival date from the hatchery lot, own Flock analytic account.
shots.0501_brooding_feed_log_draft.png: Daily feed & medication log FEED/2026/00001 in Brooding-01, recorded by the Farm Operator: the flock IHL-20-10-2026 is filled in from the nursery, no cage is needed. Starter Crumbs 150 kg, Marek's vaccine 5,000 doses, Electrolyte & Vitamin Mix 5 L (the Total Medication field adds doses and litres).
shots.0502_brooding_feed_log_confirmed.png: Confirmed: brooding feed and medication are expensed at once (Pre-Laying, Reconciled), through two consumption transfers.
Consumption transfer: Starter Crumbs from the IHL Feed Silo to the Feed Consumption virtual location.
shots.0504_brooding_feed_journal_entry.png: Journal entry of the brooding feed: 510100 Feed Expense debited, 140200 Feed Stock credited, LKR 21,000 = 150 kg x 140.
shots.0505_second_brooding_feed_log.png: Second brooding log FEED/2026/00002 (confirmed by the Farm Operator): Starter Crumbs 250 kg, Newcastle ND-IB vaccine 5,000 doses, Electrolyte & Vitamin Mix 5 L.
shots.0506_lpg_heating_bill_analytic.png: Vendor bill for LPG & electricity, 4 brooding weeks (LKR 170,000 on 510400 Brooding Heating), charged 100 % to the flock analytic account IHL-20-10-2026 (see the analytic items further on).
shots.0507_brooding_mortality_draft.png: The Farm Operator records 50 dead chicks of flock IHL-20-10-2026 in Brooding-01 (cause Disease / Infection), in Draft.
shots.0508_brooding_mortality_scrapped.png: Submitted by the Farm Operator: 50 of the 5,000 opening birds (1.00 %, not above the 2 % threshold) are scrapped at once.
shots.0509_brooding_mortality_waiting_approval: Another 60 chicks the same day: 110 cumulative = 2.20 % > 2 %. The operator cannot scrap them: the log waits for the Farm Manager, who gets a chatter alert and a To-Do.
shots.0510_brooding_mortality_approved.png: The Farm Manager approves: the 60 chicks are scrapped; Approved By and Approved Date are recorded, the To-Do is closed.
shots.0511_mortality_records.png: Mortality records of Brooding-01 for flock IHL-20-10-2026: MORT/2026/00001 (50 chicks, 1.00 %) and MORT/2026/00002 (60 chicks, 2.20 % cumulative), both Scrapped: 110 dead.
shots.0512_brooding_analytic_items.png: Analytic items of flock IHL-20-10-2026 in the brooding stage (LKR -601,500): the transfers of FEED/2026/00001 and FEED/2026/00002 (starter feed, Marek's and Newcastle vaccines, electrolytes), the two mortality scraps (50 + 60 chicks, shown with the bird product name) and the LPG bill. Every line carries the Flock account only; the Farm Cages column is empty.
shots.0513_brooding_analytic_pivot.png: Brooding-stage expenses of the batch by product (negative = cost): starter feed 400 kg, vaccines, electrolytes 10 L, mortality 110 birds; the line without product is the LPG heating bill. Total LKR 601,500.
shots.0514_brooding_investment_summary.png: Pre-Laying Flock Investment after the brooding records (still dated on the test day, age 0.0 weeks, before the arrival date is moved back): chicks LKR 750,000, starter feed LKR 56,000, vaccines and electrolytes LKR 359,000 (the quantity mixes doses and litres), LPG heating LKR 170,000 = LKR 273.01 per live bird. Brooding mortality is not added: the dead chicks are already in the chick cost.
shots.0601_brooding_ready_for_allocation.png: Brooding-01 holds 4,890 surviving birds of flock IHL-20-10-2026 (5,000 placed - 110 dead); the Farm Manager clicks Allocate Flock to Cages. In production this happens at about week 4; in the test it is done on the test day, before the flock age is simulated.
shots.0602_allocation_wizard.png: Brooding-to-Cage Allocation wizard: source nursery and flock lot detected, 4,890 live birds, the 5 cages of the estate listed with their current occupancy (all empty).
shots.0603_allocation_split_equally.png: Split Equally: 978 birds per cage (5 x 978 = 4,890), nothing left in brooding.
shots.0604_flock_rearing_stage.png: The flock keeps its lot number IHL-20-10-2026 in the cages and moves to Rearing / Pre-Laying; the chatter records the allocation. (Age 0.0 weeks and allocation on 20 October: the flock age is simulated later, before the point of lay.)
shots.0605_allocation_transfer.png: Moves of the allocation transfer: 978 birds from Brooding-01 to each of Cage A-01 to A-05, all under flock lot IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.0606_infrastructure_after_allocation.png: Farm infrastructure after the allocation: Brooding-01 is empty and each cage of Laying Shed A holds 978 birds of IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.0701_cage_feed_log_draft.png: Rearing feed log FEED/2026/00004 in Cage A-01 of Laying Shed A: the flock IHL-20-10-2026 is filled in from the cage. Grower Mash 100 kg and Electrolyte & Vitamin Mix 1 L.
shots.0702_cage_feed_log_confirmed.png: Confirmed: pre-laying feed is still a direct expense of the flock (Pre-Laying, Reconciled), now also charged to the cage.
shots.0703_feed_logs_list.png: Daily feed & medication logs, newest first: one rearing log per cage of Laying Shed A (100 kg Grower Mash + 1 L vitamins each, flock IHL-20-10-2026), then the brooding logs of BDG-20-10-2026 (Baddegama) and IHL-20-10-2026 (Ihalapannawa); all Pre-Laying, Reconciled. The Total Medication footer adds doses and litres.
shots.0704_cage_mortality_scrapped.png: Cage mortality MORT/2026/00003: 5 birds of the flock in Cage A-01 (0.51 % of its 978 birds), scrapped at once.
shots.0705_debeaking_labour_bill.png: Debeaking & bird care labour bill (LKR 75,000 on 510500 Bird Care Labour), charged to the flock analytic account IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.0706_cage_analytic_items.png: Analytic items of the rearing costs in the cages (12 lines): each line carries BOTH the flock account (Flock Batches) and the cage account (Farm Cages), so the cost is counted once and reported per flock and per cage.
shots.0707_flock_costs_by_cage_pivot.png: Analytic costs of the flock so far by cage (LKR 747,200; the LKR 750,000 chick purchase is in the bird stock value, not in analytic items). "None" = brooding and flock-level costs (LKR 676,500: vaccines, electrolytes, brooding mortality, starter feed, LPG heating, debeaking labour); one row per cage for the rearing grower feed, vitamins and cage mortality (LKR 70,700).
shots.0708_rearing_investment_summary.png: Pre-Laying Flock Investment during rearing: chicks, starter and grower feed, vaccines and vitamins, LPG heating and debeaking labour = LKR 1,479,500, i.e. LKR 303.05 per live bird (4,882), against the LKR 1,200-1,300 per bird benchmark. (Still dated on the test day, before the flock age is simulated.)
shots.0709_investment_report_pivot.png: Pre-Laying Flock Investment report: expenditure and cost per bird by flock and cost component. Cost / Bird is meaningful on the flock rows; in the Total row it is only shown where a single flock has that cost.
shots.0801_flock_18_weeks_rearing.png: Flock IHL-20-10-2026 at 18 weeks (simulated arrival 16 June), still in Rearing / Pre-Laying. Its Rolling Hen-Day field counts the 7 days up to today, 20 October, with no harvest yet on 19-20 October; the 12-18 October rate is 48.28 %, below the 50 % benchmark. (The chatter's 'moved to Rearing / Pre-Laying at 0.0 weeks' was logged before the arrival date was moved back.)
shots.0802_pre_laying_egg_collections.png: First egg collections of the pre-laying flock, 13-18 October (5 cages a day): about 31 % per cage on 13-15 October, then about 82 % on 16-18 October. The 19 October collection of Cage A-01 (top row) is still a draft.
shots.0803_egg_collection_draft.png: Egg collection of Cage A-01 on 19 October: 800 graded eggs (Large 400, Medium 240, Jumbo 80, Damaged 80). No staged feed: the flock is not laying yet, its feed is a direct expense.
shots.0804_egg_collection_produced.png: Produced: live birds snapshot 973 (Cage A-01), hen-day 82.22 %, one manufacturing order per egg grade lotted under the flock. The chatter notes that pre-laying eggs carry no feed cost.
shots.0805_pre_laying_mos.png: The 4 graded manufacturing orders of the collection (Large 400, Medium 240, Jumbo 80, Damaged 80).
shots.0806_pre_laying_mo_detail.png: Graded egg MO of a pre-laying flock: no feed component; the eggs are produced under the egg lot LOT-EGG-IHL-20-10-2026-20261019. The MO dates show 20 October, the day the simulated collection was processed; the egg lot carries the collection date.
shots.0807_laying_alert.png: The Cage A-01 harvest of 19 October pushed the 7-day rolling hen-day rate of 13-19 October to 50.6 % (17,300 eggs / 34,174 live bird days, the other cages counted with no eggs yet): the Farm Manager gets the alert "Ready to transition to Laying Phase" and a To-Do. (The Rolling Hen-Day field counts up to today, 20 October.)
shots.0808_start_laying_confirm.png: The Farm Manager clicks Start Laying Phase and confirms that the pre-laying investment will be locked. The 19 October collections of Cages A-02 to A-05 have been entered meanwhile (13-19 October: 59.99 % at the end of the day).
shots.0809_flock_laying.png: Flock IHL-20-10-2026 in Laying: Laying Phase start date and birds at point of lay recorded, the To-Do closed, the chatter logs the transition.
shots.0810_investment_locked.png: Pre-Laying Flock Investment locked at the start of the Laying Phase: LKR 1,479,500 over the 4,882 birds at point of lay = LKR 303.05 per bird.
shots.0901_laying_feed_log_draft.png: Laying feed log in Cage A-01 (20 October): Layer Mash 110 kg. The flock is Laying, so the Feeding Phase is "Laying Phase (Staged for Egg Harvest)".
shots.0902_laying_feed_staged.png: Confirmed (Staged): no stock moves yet. The feed waits for the day's egg collection, which consumes it in the egg MOs.
shots.0903_laying_collection_draft.png: Egg collection of Cage A-01 on 20 October: 870 graded eggs (Large 440, Medium 300, Jumbo 100, Damaged 30); the Staged Feed tab holds the 110 kg Layer Mash log.
shots.0904_laying_collection_produced.png: Produced: live birds snapshot, hen-day rate and FCR (kg feed per dozen eggs) recorded; 4 graded MOs consumed the 110 kg in proportion to the eggs.
shots.0905_laying_mos.png: The 4 graded MOs of the collection.
shots.0906_laying_mo_feed_component.png: Large-egg MO: 55.64 kg of Layer Mash consumed as a component, in proportion to the large eggs (440 / 870 x 110 kg = 55.63 kg; the 0.01 kg rounding remainder goes to the largest grade so that the 4 MOs consume exactly 110 kg); finished eggs under lot LOT-EGG-IHL-20-10-2026-20261020.
shots.0907_egg_lot_parent_flock.png: Egg lot LOT-EGG-IHL-20-10-2026-20261020 (Large): Parent Flock IHL-20-10-2026 and Egg Production Date, used to trace sales back to the flock.
shots.0908_egg_cold_store_by_lot.png: Graded eggs in the Egg Cold Store by product and daily flock egg lot (13-20 October): Damaged 2,200, Jumbo 2,550, Large 12,490, Medium 7,650 = 24,890 eggs.
shots.0909_laying_feed_analytic.png: Analytic items of the laying feed (Layer Mash, LKR 120 / kg) consumed by the 20 egg MOs of 20 October: each line carries the flock account IHL-20-10-2026 and the cage account of the producing cage; LKR 13,200 (110 kg) per cage.
shots.0910_egg_production_analysis.png: Egg Production Analysis by flock and cage, per grade: 24,890 eggs on 13-20 October. The Hen-Day (%) under a grade is the flock rate weighted by the share of the eggs of that grade, not a per-grade laying rate; the overall rate is 63.73 %.
shots.1001_egg_sale_order.png: Egg sale order confirmed: Large 3,000 @ 45, Medium 2,000 @ 40, Jumbo 600 @ 50, Damaged 200 @ 20 (LKR 249,000).
shots.1002_egg_delivery_done.png: Egg delivery validated from the Egg Cold Store.
shots.1003_egg_delivery_lots.png: Delivered egg lots: the oldest flock egg lots (LOT-EGG-IHL-20-10-2026-<date>) are taken first; each lot links back to flock IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.1004_egg_sale_lines_analytic.png: After the delivery the sale lines carry the analytic distribution of the delivered lots: 100 % flock IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.1005_spent_hen_sale_order.png: End of cycle (simulated): the spent hens of the flock are sold, all its live birds at LKR 650.
shots.1006_spent_hen_delivery_from_cages.png: Spent hen delivery: the birds leave the 5 cages of Laying Shed A under flock lot IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.1007_spent_hen_delivery_done.png: Spent hen delivery validated: the cages are empty.
shots.1008_egg_invoice_analytic.png: Posted egg invoice (LKR 249,000): every line carries the flock analytic account IHL-20-10-2026.
shots.1009_spent_hen_invoice.png: Posted spent hen invoice, tagged to the flock account.
shots.1010_flock_spent.png: The Farm Manager marks the flock Spent / Depleted: depletion date recorded, no live birds left.
shots.1011_cages_empty_for_next_flock.png: The permanent cages of Laying Shed A are empty, ready for cleaning and the next flock; BDG-20-10-2026 is still brooding in Baddegama.
